U.note: Clear pelican with big pouch seated on a detailed bike with chain, spinning spoked wheels and scrolling road; pause, cadence and honk all work, though the wing and body overlap the frame a little awkwardly.

V.note: Simple, readable pelican on a bike with parallax hills and clouds and working pause and speed, but the neck and frame are crude and the pelican is a bit generic.

W.note: Pleasant scene with a bell, DING text and distance readout, but the pelican floats above a thin frame, the wheels are faint, and the wing arm is pale and plain.

X.note: Recognisable pelican on a teal bike with scrolling scenery and pedals, but the grey triangular wing is odd, the legs read thinly and the frame geometry is off.

Y.note: Dark-themed page with a fun helmeted pelican, reverse, honk and distance readout; the pelican and bike are clean but the wing is a flat slab and the legs are thin.

Z.note: Most polished build with a cargo crate, chain, eased start and stop, reverse, bell with sound, a status line and 44px controls; the pelican is small, and the crate and loaf and fish are an addition beyond the request.
